description: This file defines the Floor class which implements various floor rounding functions (such as FLOOR, FLOOR.MATH, and FLOOR.PRECISE) for spreadsheet calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for rounding numbers down to specified significance with different modes, handling array inputs, and error checking.

classes.name: Floor
classes.description: Provides static methods implementing various floor rounding functions compatible with Excel formulas, handling both scalar and array inputs, and managing different modes and error conditions within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

methods.name: floor
methods.description: Performs the FLOOR function, rounding a number down toward zero to the nearest multiple of significance, with support for array inputs and handling missing significance argument.

methods.name: math
methods.description: Implements the FLOOR.MATH function, allowing custom rounding modes and handling array inputs for complex rounding scenarios.

methods.name: precise
methods.description: Implements the FLOOR.PRECISE function, rounding a number toward zero to the nearest multiple of significance, supporting arrays.

methods.name: argumentsOkPrecise
methods.description: Internal method to verify arguments for FLOOR.PRECISE, returning either a rounded value or an error.

methods.name: argsOk
methods.description: Internal method to perform validation and rounding logic for FLOOR.MATH, considering the mode parameter.

methods.name: floorMathTest
methods.description: Helper method to decide if special FLOOR.MATH rounding logic should be applied based on input signs and mode.

methods.name: argumentsOk
methods.description: Internal method to validate arguments and perform the standard FLOOR rounding logic.
